//overrides: rimraf: google-gax@5 and gaxios@7 both declare rimraf but neither imports
it anywhere in their shipped JS (verified by grep). The transitive rimraf@5
only serves to pull glob@10 -> minimatch@9 -> brace-expansion@2, which
carries the GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg DoS advisory (fixed only in
brace-expansion >= 5.0.8). rimraf@6 uses the internally consistent
brace-expansion directly does NOT work: minimatch@9 consumes it as a
default export and brace-expansion@5 only has a named `expand` export, so
the call site dies with 'brace_expansion_1.default is not a function'.
Drop this override once google-gax removes its unused rimraf dependency.
